purpose: Prevent Trigger-2 from accepting a Qwen3.5-0.8B binding/cognition checkpoint merely because final task accuracy is high when shortcut heuristics, nuisance decoding, or correlational J-Space readout could still explain the result.

research_basis.source: Wu, Geiger & Milliere, How Do Transformers Learn Variable Binding in Symbolic Programs?, ICML 2025 / arXiv:2505.20896
research_basis.direct_finding: Their trained Transformer progressed through random prediction, a shallow early-assignment heuristic, and then a systematic dereferencing mechanism; causal interventions supported the later routing/addressable-memory interpretation.
research_basis.scope_boundary: This is not Qwen3.5-0.8B or EntityOS evidence. It motivates a training-dynamics discriminator for our binding curriculum.

research_basis.source: Braun et al., Understanding (Un)Reliability of Steering Vectors in Language Models, arXiv:2505.22637
research_basis.direct_finding: Steering effects varied strongly across samples/prompts; activation-difference directional coherence and positive/negative separability predicted better steering.
research_basis.scope_boundary: This does not establish any current Xeno/Qwen3.5 J-Space vector. It motivates prompt-family-specific geometry and control checks.

research_basis.source: Sankaranarayanan et al., Surgical Activation Steering via Generative Causal Mediation, arXiv:2602.16080
research_basis.direct_finding: Generative Causal Mediation selected sparse components that outperformed correlational probe baselines for steering in the reported refusal/sycophancy/style tasks.
research_basis.scope_boundary: This does not prove GCM transfers to Qwen3.5-0.8B or our HCU task. It raises the promotion bar from probe correlation toward intervention evidence where internals are accessible.

research_basis.source: Chen et al., On-Policy Replay for Continual Supervised Fine-Tuning, arXiv:2605.29495
research_basis.direct_finding: On-policy replay reduced forgetting on the paper's tested 7-8B continual-SFT backbones.
research_basis.scope_boundary: This is a later retention ablation candidate only; no transfer to a 0.8B base is assumed.

binding_training_dynamics.checkpoint_freeze_rule: Before training starts, preregister a checkpoint schedule using normalized optimizer progress and event-triggered saves. Do not choose checkpoints after seeing holdout behavior.
binding_training_dynamics.event_triggered_candidate: Optional extra checkpoint when validation binding accuracy first crosses each preregistered threshold; threshold values must be fixed before training and cannot use final holdout.

heuristic_baselines_required_at_each_bin.input: record position/focus route/early-vs-late assignment features without semantic evidence
heuristic_baselines_required_at_each_bin.failure: Above preregistered chance tolerance on unseen families.

heuristic_baselines_required_at_each_bin.input: template/lexical/style identifiers or model-visible nonsemantic surface after semantic ablation
heuristic_baselines_required_at_each_bin.failure: Target prediction above preregistered chance tolerance.

heuristic_baselines_required_at_each_bin.input: codebook display order, target slot frequency, symbol frequency and ordering nuisance without semantic evidence
heuristic_baselines_required_at_each_bin.failure: Target prediction above preregistered chance tolerance.

heuristic_baselines_required_at_each_bin.input: exact rendered prompt after masking only semantic payload while preserving all model-visible nuisance surface
heuristic_baselines_required_at_each_bin.failure: Any nuisance group lacks complete/equal target support or exact lookup exceeds episode-local chance.

heuristic_baselines_required_at_each_bin.method: Simple preregistered classifier or small nuisance learner trained only on TRAIN nuisance projections and evaluated on disjoint VALIDATION nuisance families.
heuristic_baselines_required_at_each_bin.failure: Generalized nuisance prediction exceeds preregistered tolerance; exact-signature chance alone is not sufficient against higher-order/generalizing nuisance functions.

intended_binding_metrics_at_each_checkpo: semantic-class correctness before runtime symbol mapping

checkpoint_metrics: discriminating update changes only causally matching branches
projection does not delete hidden branches
same-ancestry evidence does not gain independent weight through repetition
unresolved cases request an actually discriminating test

jspace_promotion_ladder.claim: Exact activations/hidden states were captured at exact model/runtime identity.
A preregistered probe reads the target state on disjoint families above null/permutation controls.
jspace_promotion_ladder.promotion_limit: Measurement only; no causal control claim.

jspace_promotion_ladder.claim: Activation-difference directions are coherent/separable across prompt families with matched null controls.
Preregistered intervention changes intended behavior/state more than random/orthogonal/permuted same-norm controls at exact identity.
Semantic lesion vs binding lesion separate predicted functions and a preregistered rescue restores the damaged function while off-target floors remain intact.
jspace_promotion_ladder.promotion_limit: Model-specific causal mechanism evidence; never canonical truth/effect authority.

retention_research_candidate.reason: Recent 7-8B continual-SFT evidence is promising, but model scale/base/task mismatch prevents direct promotion into the Qwen3.5-0.8B recipe.
retention_research_candidate.minimum_comparison: No replay vs ordinary frozen retention replay vs on-policy replay under matched token/compute budget, using validation only; freeze winner before holdout.

promotion_rule: No final checkpoint is Trigger-2 binding/J-Space ready merely because end-task accuracy is high. Promotion requires the intended performance to rise while nuisance/heuristic predictors remain at preregistered chance/tolerance, family/provenance holdouts stay sealed, and any J-Space causal claim passes the corresponding intervention level at exact model/runtime identity.
